title: Wellington Fall Festival 2026
desc: The village's free fall festival with bounce houses, hay rides, a petting zoo, laser tag, costume contests, food trucks and the one-night-only Haunted Hallways. Activity bracelets required; free shuttle from The Mall at Wellington Green.

title: Palm Beach Polo Season 2026 to 2027
desc: The winter polo season at the USPA's National Polo Center, with weekly matches and Sunday polo through spring, highlighted by the Gauntlet of Polo tournaments.

title: Adequan Global Dressage Festival 2027
dateNote: January 13 to March 21, 2027 (competition weeks; see our guide for dates)
desc: International dressage competition at Wellington International with CDI5* classes, World Cup qualifiers and Friday Night Stars freestyles under the lights. Free daytime admission. Full week-by-week dates in our 2027 dressage guide.

title: Winter Equestrian Festival 2027
desc: Thirteen weeks of international show jumping, hunters and equitation, one of the largest horse shows in the world.
